Krator biome — the geyser basin (the Steampits)
Krator biome kit — the geyser basin: a basin in the Steampits on the Ring Sea's north shore (~1.5 km below the datum, ~1.9 atm, ~33 °C), cut into the hyperjungle. Geysers on sinter cones erupting on their own cycles, prismatic springs with mat-banded run-off, mud pots and fumaroles, travertine terraces stepping down to the sea, a dead forest drowned in silica at the edges, and the thermophile life of the warm ground (ideal type) · click to inspect · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom · right-drag / WASD to move · G erupts the geyser nearest the view
